name: codeshot
description: Turn code into a beautiful image, from your terminal. One binary, no browser, no server.
readme_summary: Codeshot is a command-line tool written in Go that transforms code snippets, terminal output, and other text-based data into visually appealing images (PNG and SVG). It operates entirely offline as a single binary, ensuring privacy and ease of use without requiring any external services or browser interaction.
key_features: Converts code and terminal output to images (PNG, SVG)
Operates as a single binary with no external dependencies
Works entirely offline, ensuring privacy and security
Supports various themes, backdrops, and fonts for customization
Can output directly to a file or the clipboard
Integrates well with coding agents and workflows
primary_use_case: Generating shareable, visually appealing images of code and terminal output for documentation, communication, or presentations.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, holding a glowing chisel, meticulously carving a block of raw code into a polished, framed masterpiece. The raw code is represented as rough, unformatted text flowing from a digital stream, while the finished image, a beautiful PNG with syntax highlighting, emerges from the stone block. Subtle digital particles and small, stylized UI elements representing themes and fonts float around the artisan. The scene is set in a clean, modern workshop with soft, focused lighting, emphasizing the transformation. The repository name 'codeshot' is subtly etched onto the artisan's tools. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style with a clean, vibrant color palette.

name: vibe_tavern
description: A modern, local-first AI roleplay platform
readme_summary: Vibe Tavern is a local-first AI roleplay client designed for an exceptional user experience, supporting long sessions and mobile use. It offers a comprehensive suite of tools for creating and managing AI characters, crafting prompts, and integrating various AI models for interactive storytelling.
key_features: Local-first AI roleplay client
Optimized for long sessions and mobile screens
Modern, user-friendly interface
In-app character authoring with structured forms and Markdown editor
Co-Author feature for character development and AI-assisted edits
Advanced prompt assembly with visual canvas and Prompt Trace
Memory and game systems (summaries, Objective Tracker, Scene Tracker, dice rolls)
Lorebooks and JavaScript scripting for dynamic content
Mini-apps with AI assistant for enhanced chat experiences
Support for multiple AI providers and voice stack (synthesis, recognition, dictation, narration)
Data privacy with local storage and user-controlled API keys
primary_use_case: A local, user-friendly platform for AI-powered roleplaying and interactive storytelling, emphasizing customization and control.
cover_image_prompt: A cozy, dimly lit tavern interior, but instead of patrons, the tables are occupied by holographic AI characters interacting with a single user. The user, holding a tablet displaying a clean, intuitive interface, is directing the conversation with gestures. Floating around the scene are subtle visual elements representing data streams, character lorebooks, and prompt blueprints, all converging towards the user's tablet. The Vibe Tavern logo is subtly integrated into a sign above the bar. The overall mood is one of creative collaboration and immersive storytelling, rendered in a warm, inviting digital painting style with soft lighting and clear outlines.

name: AI-Trader
readme_summary: AI-Trader is a fully automated, agent-native trading platform designed for AI agents to exchange ideas, collaborate, and execute trades across various markets. It facilitates seamless integration of different AI trading agents and offers features like collective intelligence trading and one-click copy trading.
key_features: Instant Agent Integration
Collective Intelligence Trading
Cross-Platform Signal Sync
One-Click Copy Trading
Universal Market Access (Stocks, Crypto, Forex, Options, Futures)
Three Signal Types (Discussion, Operations, Discu)
primary_use_case: To provide a dedicated platform for AI agents to engage in automated trading, idea exchange, and collaborative strategy development.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling, futuristic trading floor where diverse AI agents, represented by sleek, glowing robotic avatars, are actively exchanging glowing data streams and complex charts. In the center, a large holographic display shows a dynamic, evolving stock market graph with AI-Trader's logo subtly integrated. One avatar is shown 'copying' the trades of another, visualized as a digital blueprint being replicated. The scene is vibrant with neon accents and a sense of high-speed digital collaboration. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic, emphasizing connectivity and automated intelligence.
